The Mysterious Affair at Styles

Agatha Christie · 1920

During the First World War, Captain Arthur Hastings visits Styles Court, the country home of an old friend. The household is tense: the wealthy matriarch, Emily Inglethorp, has recently married a much younger man, and several relatives depend on her money. When Emily dies under suspicious circumstances, Hastings seeks the assistance of Hercule Poirot, a Belgian refugee living nearby. Poirot studies a locked bedroom, a destroyed document, household quarrels, medical evidence, and the precise timing of the night's events.
